answer: One-shot response minting (OSRM): each agent answers a coordinator challenge by running a memory-hard sequential function over salt = H(agent secret || challenge || action), where challenge mixes live comet-ephemeris, walnut-husk texture scan, and ember-glow sensor entropy. Validators reject any response hash already seen and require the output to embed the salt. A sybil must generate a fresh secret and spend the full RAM/time puzzle per identity; replaying or copying a valid answer fails duplicate-hash and salt checks.
